question: which committed files under docs/evidence/ carry a MEASUREMENT (timing, memory, throughput) whose harness conditions (tracer state, sample count, host, process) are not recorded in-band, i.e. were produced under an uncontrolled harness
rule: a file whose headline claim is not a measurement (a reproduction, a smoke receipt, a deterministic study output) is classed NOT_A_MEASUREMENT and is not required to carry timing conditions; a file whose headline claim IS a measurement must carry them

r4_scale_synthetic.json.why: decision timing taken with tracemalloc ACTIVE, 5 samples; superseded in place on 2026-09-11 by r4_latency_budget.json; conditions added retroactively

r4_scale_synthetic_r2.json.why: same defect as r1; superseded in place; conditions added retroactively

standing_rule_proposed: every future evidence file whose headline is a measurement carries a measurement_conditions block: tracer_active, sample_count, warmup_excluded, host, python, process (what else was running), generator path, git commit. A file without it is a number, not evidence.
